accepted.quote: H.R. 3494 would compound those issues by authorizing a Veterans Health Administration pilot, prior to the Department standardizing and deciding its path forward.
accepted.rationale: Takano opposes authorizing the VHA supply-chain pilot before VA develops a comprehensive strategy.

accepted.quote: As VA increasingly considers external solutions for modernization efforts like supply chain, Democratic Members are concerned by the potential conflicts of interest that may arise from SGEs, particularly those that work with the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) initiative.
accepted.rationale: Takano expresses concern about SGE conflicts of interest in VA contracting, supporting ethics safeguards.
